text_block_list.text:
The Nippon Derby, the race so many 
Umamusume dream of. With tomorrow being 
the big day, Satono Diamond is more pumped 
up than ever.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I took care of the preparations, such as 
the outfit and shoeing, yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, today we can focus entirely on the 
finishing touches!
choice_data_list: Even so, it's just fine-tuning, though.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We certainly cannot let any fatigue 
linger. I shall follow your instructions, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—It looks like we'll be blessed with fine 
weather tomorrow.
And then, the day of the Japanese Derby—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is almost time. Fufu, everything is 
going swimmingly today♪

Satono Diamond is in great spirits. Just 
as she said, unlike at the Satsuki Sho, 
arriving at the racecourse went smoothly 
today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One last check on the horseshoes...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kya!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The shoes are...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the sole was torn... It 
seems to have ripped right from where the 
horseshoe nails were held in...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
………… ...Everything seemed fine when I 
checked yesterday...

"I examine the shoes, but repairing them 
looks difficult. There's no choice but to 
use the spare pair."

Fortunately, Satono Diamond already had 
her spare horseshoes properly fitted.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ......Yes, I'm okay!
choice_data_list: Good thing we caught it before the race!
Good thing we caught it before the race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Something that usually never happens 
occurred once again...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Both the Satsuki Sho and the Japan Derby. 
Why does this keep happening only in the 
vital Classic Triple Crown races...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Almost as if standing in the way of 
Satono's long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...It feels like something is trying to 
hold me back...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...So this is the power of the Satono 
jinx...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Still!! I will not lose! I will shatter 
every single jinx into pieces!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's what I've sworn all this time!! 
So...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win the Japanese Derby! No 
matter what!!
